comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (a48d2a1 Vec, b3c30c7 the #74 fix). Bounded Vec<T> (Type::Vec, a newtype TVecU64 over vstd::vec::Vec<u64> with well_formed len<=CAP). checked_get -> L3 pure (no-OOB accessor; req i<v.len() genuinely load-bearing, off-by-one -> L0); push_one -> L3 alloc (capacity-preserving, final(self) ens). Critic confirmed crux sound (bounds-checked get, real capacity invariant, no cheat, no regression) + found #74: push_one was L0 because the #12 mutation scorer couldn't synthesize a Vec-return mutant (0/0 -> #48 backstop -> WeakContract) -> fixed by synthesizing an empty-Vec early-return mutant (the #48-analog: empty Vec -> ens len==v.len()+1 false -> killed -> 1/1 -> L3); anti-Goodhart intact (weak Vec contract still WeakContract); CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION 2->3 (the #49 cache-invalidation contract). Element invariant (Vec<Account>) + Map DEFERRED to v1.1. workspace 480 tests. Stage 4 complete.
